description: Catalog of successful builds for agent learning - patterns that work well

successfulBuilds.name: Efficient Starter Base
steps: Dig 2 blocks into hillside for quick shelter
Expand to 5x5x3 interior space
Place crafting table and furnace immediately
Add door and 2 glass panes for light
Place 4 torches on walls
lessonsLearned: Building into terrain is faster than building walls
Light prevents mob spawns inside
Small space is better than no space at night

successfulBuilds.name: Simple Watchtower
steps: Build 4x4 stone brick base
Raise walls 12 blocks high
Add interior ladder for access
Create 6x6 viewing platform at top
Add 2-high crenellations around edge
lessonsLearned: Start small and build up
Interior access is essential
Overhang at top looks better

successfulBuilds.name: Compact Efficient Farm
steps: Dig 1-block deep 9x9 area
Place water in center block
Hoe all surrounding dirt
Plant seeds in all 80 farmable blocks
Fence perimeter and add torches
lessonsLearned: One water block hydrates 4 blocks in each direction
Torches let crops grow at night
Fencing keeps mobs from trampling

successfulBuilds.name: Safe Mining Shaft
steps: Dig 2x1 shaft straight down (stand on edge)
Place ladders every block
At Y=-59, dig 2-block high horizontal tunnel
Branch mine every 3 blocks
Light everything thoroughly
lessonsLearned: Y=-59 is optimal for diamonds in 1.21
Never dig straight down without ladder backup
Torches on left wall helps navigation

successfulBuilds.name: Ravine Bridge
steps: Build 3-wide cobblestone path across gap
Add fence railings on both sides
For spans over 10 blocks, add support pillars
lessonsLearned: 3 blocks wide is comfortable
Railings prevent accidental falls
Crouch while building over void

successfulBuilds.name: Coastal Lighthouse
steps: Build 8x8 circular stone base on coastline
Raise cylindrical tower 25-30 blocks high
Alternate white concrete bands every 5 blocks
Create 12x12 glass observation deck at top
Fill top with glowstone for beacon effect
Add spiral staircase inside for access
lessonsLearned: Circles need careful block placement - use online templates
Height makes structure visible from far away
Glowstone works as beacon without needing a real beacon

successfulBuilds.name: Medieval Castle
steps: Build 20x20 foundation with 3-block thick walls
Add 4 corner towers (5x5, 15 blocks tall)
Connect towers with crenellated walls (8 blocks high)
Add main gatehouse with iron doors
Build central keep (10x10, 20 blocks tall)
Add interior rooms: great hall, armory, throne room
Decorate with banners, armor stands, carpets
lessonsLearned: Work from outside in - walls first, then interior
Corner towers anchor the design
Crenellations add authenticity
Interior decoration makes it feel lived-in

successfulBuilds.name: Golden Pyramid
steps: Mark 21x21 base in desert biome
Build solid gold pyramid stepping in 1 block per layer
Hollow out interior for tomb chambers
Add hidden entrance with pressure plate
Create sarcophagus room with gold and quartz
Line corridors with glowstone behind sandstone
lessonsLearned: Pyramids look best with odd-numbered bases
Hidden entrances add mystery
Interior lighting through blocks creates atmosphere

successfulBuilds.name: Jungle Treehouse
steps: Find large jungle tree or build trunk from logs
Build main platform at Y+15-20 from ground
Add multiple connected platforms at varying heights
Connect with rope bridges (fence with trapdoors)
Add walls only on 2 sides for open-air feel
Drape vines from edges for natural look
lessonsLearned: Use existing trees when possible
Multiple levels add visual interest
Open sides show off the jungle view

successfulBuilds.name: Underwater Glass Dome
steps: Build dome frame underwater using sand/gravel scaffolding
Replace scaffolding with glass panes
Add prismarine ring at base and top
Use sponges to clear water from inside
Add sea lanterns for illumination
Build airlock entrance with doors
Furnish interior with viewing areas
lessonsLearned: Sponges are essential for clearing water
Build frame first, then fill in glass
Prismarine matches ocean aesthetic

walls.basic: Place blocks in a line, 3+ high
walls.pillared: Place corner pillars first, fill between with different material
walls.windowed: Leave 1x2 gaps every 3 blocks for glass
walls.layered: Alternate materials every 2 rows for texture

roofs.curved: Multiple stair types for dome effect

foundations.stilts: Pillars in water or uneven terrain

decorations.lighting: Lanterns hanging from fences, torches on walls
decorations.greenery: Flower pots, leaves, vines on exteriors
decorations.furniture: Stairs as chairs, slabs as tables
decorations.storage: Chest rooms with signs for organization

commonMistakes.solution: Place blocks to seal entrance if no door
Add depth with stairs, slabs, pillars
Check surroundings for caves, cliffs first
Stone pickaxe for stone, axe for wood
